description: ⚠️ Beta — SQL Prompt-like IntelliSense for T-SQL in VS Code. Features may change.
config.title: T-SQL IntelliSense
config.connectionsMarkdown: Saved database connections — **[Add Connection](command:tsql-intellisense.addConnection)** | **[Manage in SQL Prompt Options](command:tsql-intellisense.openStyleSettings)**
config.connections.name: Connection profile name
config.connections.projectPath: SQL Server Database Project directory path for automatic file sync on DDL execution
config.autoRefreshMinutes: Auto-refresh schema cache interval in minutes (0 to disable)
config.resultDisplayMode: How to display multiple result sets: 'tabs' (switch between tabs) or 'stacked' (all visible, vertically)
config.gridLibrary: Grid library for query results: 'tabulator', 'ag-grid', or 'handsontable'
config.queryShortcuts: SSMS-style query shortcuts. Use @WORD as placeholder for the word under cursor.
config.queryShortcuts.query: SQL query to execute. @WORD = word under cursor
config.snippetFolder: Path to the directory containing Redgate SQL Prompt snippet JSON files
config.snippetFolderMarkdown: Path to Redgate SQL Prompt snippet JSON files — **[Browse...](command:tsql-intellisense.setSnippetFolder)**
config.assignAliases: Automatically assign alias when a table/view is selected
config.includeAS: Use AS in alias definition (FROM Table AS t)
config.capitaliseAliases: Generate aliases in uppercase (SA instead of sa)
config.prefixesToIgnore: Table name prefixes to ignore when generating aliases (e.g. Cv_Rn, Tb_Rn)
config.qualifyWithOwner: Add dbo. schema prefix to table/view names
config.joinMatchingNames: Suggest columns with matching names in JOIN conditions
config.joinSwapColumnOrder: Swap column order in JOIN conditions (FROM table on the left)
config.maxLineLength: Maximum line length for SQL formatting (0 = no wrap)
config.styleFile: Path to Redgate SQL Prompt style file (.json)
config.styleOverrides: Manual casing settings (saved from Formatting Styles panel)
config.openOptionsPanel: For language settings, style file import, and visual formatting options: **[Open SQL Prompt Options](command:tsql-intellisense.openStyleSettings)**
config.queryHistory.maxQuerySize: Maximum query size in bytes to save in history (queries exceeding this are not saved)
config.queryHistory.maxEntries: Maximum number of history entries to keep
config.queryHistory.retentionDays: Automatically delete history entries older than this many days (0 to keep forever)
config.ws.spacesOrTabs: Use spaces or tabs for indentation
config.ws.numberOfSpaces: Number of spaces per tab stop
config.ws.wrapLines: Wrap lines longer than this many characters (0 = no wrap)
config.ws.emptyLinesBetween: Number of empty lines between statements
config.ws.emptyLinesAfterBatch: Number of empty lines after batch separator (GO)
config.ws.preserveEmptyBetween: Preserve existing empty lines between statements
config.ws.preserveEmptyWithin: Preserve existing empty lines within statements
config.ws.alignMultilineComments: Align multiline comments matching common patterns
config.cf.placeBeginOnNewLine: Place BEGIN keyword on a new line
config.cf.indentContents: Indent contents of control flow statements
config.cf.collapseShort: Collapse short control flow statements to a single line
config.cf.collapseShortLen: Collapse control flow statements shorter than this many characters
config.var.alignDataTypes: Align data types and values in DECLARE statements
config.var.addSpaceBetween: Add a space between data type and precision in DECLARE
config.var.setPlaceValueOnNewLine: Place assigned value on new line if longer than wrap column
config.var.setPlaceEqualsOnNewLine: Place equals sign on new line in SET statements
config.dml.clauseAlignment: Clause alignment for DML statements (toStatement or toKeyword)
config.dml.collapseShort: Collapse short DML statements to a single line
config.dml.collapseShortLen: Collapse DML statements shorter than this many characters
config.ddl.alignDataTypes: Align data types and constraints in CREATE TABLE
config.ddl.placeFirstParam: Place first procedure parameter on new line (never, always, ifMultiple)
config.ddl.collapseShort: Collapse short DDL statements to a single line
config.ddl.collapseShortLen: Collapse DDL statements shorter than this many characters
walkthrough.title: Get Started with T-SQL IntelliSense
walkthrough.description: Learn how to connect to SQL Server and use IntelliSense, query execution, formatting, and navigation features.
walkthrough.addConnection.title: Add a Database Connection
walkthrough.addConnection.description:
Configure your first SQL Server connection to enable IntelliSense and query execution.

[Add Connection](command:tsql-intellisense.addConnection)
walkthrough.objectExplorer.title: Explore Your Database
walkthrough.objectExplorer.description: Browse tables, views, stored procedures, and functions in the Object Explorer tree view — just like SSMS.
walkthrough.intellisense.title: Use Smart IntelliSense
walkthrough.intellisense.description: Open a `.sql` file and start typing — get context-aware completions for tables, columns, SPs, and more.
walkthrough.runQuery.title: Run a Query
walkthrough.runQuery.description:
Press **F5** to execute your SQL and see results in a sortable grid with CSV/JSON export.

[Run Query](command:tsql-intellisense.runQuery)
walkthrough.formatSql.title: Format Your SQL
walkthrough.formatSql.description:
Auto-format SQL with keyword casing, clause alignment, and Redgate SQL Prompt style support.

[Format SQL](command:tsql-intellisense.formatSql)
walkthrough.goToDefinition.title: Navigate with F12 & F2
walkthrough.goToDefinition.description: Press **F12** on any object to view its definition. Press **F2** on an alias to rename it across the query.
